SELECT TOP (0) CAST(NULL AS int) AS room_id, CAST(NULL AS int) AS peak_concurrent;
hint: Biến start thành +1, end thành -1 và gộp delta theo cùng timestamp trước running sum.
solution:
WITH c AS (SELECT room_id,CASE WHEN starts_at<'20260101' THEN CAST('20260101' AS datetime2(0)) ELSE starts_at END s,
 CASE WHEN ends_at>'20260102' THEN CAST('20260102' AS datetime2(0)) ELSE ends_at END e
 FROM #ClinicAppointments WHERE status<>N'cancelled' AND starts_at<'20260102' AND ends_at>'20260101'),
v AS (SELECT room_id,s at_time,1 delta FROM c UNION ALL SELECT room_id,e,-1 FROM c),
d AS (SELECT room_id,at_time,SUM(delta) delta FROM v GROUP BY room_id,at_time),
r AS (SELECT room_id,SUM(delta) OVER(PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY at_time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) concurrent_count FROM d),
p AS (SELECT room_id,MAX(concurrent_count) peak FROM r GROUP BY room_id)
SELECT x.room_id,COALESCE(p.peak,0) peak_concurrent FROM #ClinicRooms x LEFT JOIN p ON p.room_id=x.room_id;
explanation: Sweep line xử lý các boundary thay vì lấy mẫu từng phút. Gộp delta cùng mốc bảo toàn semantics nửa mở, còn MAX prefix sum là peak thật trong khoảng đã cắt theo ngày.

r AS (SELECT *,DATEADD(minute,-15*CONVERT(int,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY starts_at,slot_id)),starts_at) island FROM f),

 FROM #ClinicRequests q JOIN b ON b.free_minutes>=q.minutes_needed)
